meta.description: Expands the young fruit body over time by inflating the hyphae it has: the stem stretches, the cap opens and the veil tears into a ring. Grows no new hyphae, so it is cheap to run for every time.

t.description: The time from 0 to 1, connect the time node

elongation.description: How far the stem has stretched over the time

opening.description: How far the cap has opened over the time, the gills follow it

stipe_stretch.description: How much longer the stem gets, 2 makes it three times as long

apical_stretch.description: 0 stretches the stem evenly, 1 only towards the top

cap_spread.description: How much wider the cap gets, 1 doubles it

open_angle.description: Angle to the vertical the cap opens to, 0 is up, 0.5 sideways, 1 down. Parts pointing down further turn up to it.

gill_deepening.description: How much deeper the gills get while the cap opens

inflation.description: How much thicker the hyphae of stem, cap and gills get

veil_extensibility.description: The veil tears once the gap between cap margin and stem is this many times as wide as at the start

tear_position.description: Where the veil tears, 0 at the stem leaves it on the cap margin, 1 at the margin leaves it as a ring on the stem
